name: Fairness Guarded by Drop
description: Improve fairness by reweighting per-UE scheduling while enforcing a drop-rate guardrail based on an externally provided baseline. The xApp raises weightUE for low-throughput UEs only when windowed drop ratio stays within a small rise tolerance. It may reduce throughput if fairness gains are large.

control_parameters.semantic: Per-UE scheduling weights used by the scheduler to bias PRB allocation toward fairness.
